_comment: Six-lab judge panel. Diversity is the point: seats from six different labs fail in different directions, which is the only cheap signal that a score is real rather than one model's taste. All slugs verified against the live OpenRouter catalog — re-run `npm run verify:panel` before a gauntlet, since slugs drift.

_verified.gemini-3.7-flash: text+image+VIDEO+audio, 1.05M ctx, $0.38/$1.88 — only seat with native video
_verified.deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash: TEXT ONLY, 1.05M ctx, $0.09/$0.18 — cheapest seat, judge panel only

_notes: deepseek is deliberately absent from visualPanel: deepseek-v4-flash is text-only, so it would score visual evidence it cannot see. Swap in deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp ($0.22/$0.66) if you want a deepseek seat on the visual panel.
gemini and kimi are the only two seats that receive the scroll RECORDING; the rest get sampled keyframes and are flagged degraded:'video->frames' on the round.
gemini and grok seats sit on their direct APIs, not OpenRouter — if OpenRouter has an outage the panel still reaches quorum.
grok seats carry `enabled` so they can be benched with one word; set false and lower panelQuorum.judge to 3 and visual to 2.
panelQuorum.judge=4 of 6 means two dead seats still produce a verdict, three does not.
maxJudgeSpread=25 blocks shipping when the panel is genuinely split rather than averaging the disagreement away.
